user.title: Select your EasyWallbox
user.description: Wallboxes seen by your Bluetooth adapters or ESPHome Bluetooth proxies.

manual.title: EasyWallbox MAC address
manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of the wallbox (e.g. 8C:F6:81:AA:BB:CC). It must be in range of a connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.

pin.title: BLE PIN
pin.description: Enter the BLE PIN of {name} ({address}). It is the `A:` field of the QR code on the wallbox label (not the `P:` pairing passkey). Close the manufacturer app first: the wallbox only accepts one BLE connection.

data_description.pin: Usually 4 digits, field A: of the QR label.

reauth_confirm.title: Wrong PIN
reauth_confirm.description: The wallbox rejected the PIN. Enter the correct BLE PIN (field A: of the QR label).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the wallbox. Check the proxy is close enough and the manufacturer app is closed.
error.not_in_range: The wallbox is not in range of any connectable Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be 4 to 6 digits.

data_description.dpm_default: Used by the charging switch when no previous DPM limit is known.
data_description.pair: Disable only if your adapter fails when pairing is requested.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a raw protocol command to the wallbox (advanced, may change EEPROM settings).

config_entry_id.name: Wallbox
config_entry_id.description: EasyWallbox to send the command to.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a reply.
